data.exact_reserve_text: Net claims (strengthening)/release (22,690) [from table 7 on page 14]. The Ministry of Justice made an announcement on 27 February 2017 to revise the personal injury ("Ogden") discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% effective 20 March 2017. As the Ogden discount rate is applied to the syndicate's long-tail motor liabilities that existed at the balance sheet date, the syndicate has applied this revised discount rate on the valuation of its reported claims provision at 31 December 2016. The effect of this revision is shown below. Revision of Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% Change in claims outstanding - gross (155,750) [from table 27 on page 17].

prior_year_events.impact_description: Revision of Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75% causing deteriorations in the gross position for long-tail motor liabilities, applied to the 31 December 2016 valuation.

data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a gross strengthening of prior year reserves of GBP 133.060 million in 2016, representing 23.31% of its opening gross claims outstanding. This was primarily driven by the revision of the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75%, which resulted in a gross strengthening of GBP 155.750 million for long-tail motor liabilities. Prior to this Ogden impact, the syndicate had a release of GBP 22.690 million from its prior accident year claims provisions. The overall gross position deteriorated due to the Ogden change, though the net impact was reduced by reinsurance recoveries. The Ogden rate change affected motor liabilities from prior years.
raw_causal_phrases: change in the Ogden discount rate from 2.5% to minus 0.75%

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: The prior year development figure is a combination of the pre-Ogden movement from the 'Movement in prior accident year's provision for claims outstanding' table and the subsequent Ogden discount rate revision impact on 2016 claims outstanding.
